# WHY ✴︎ GGG

> Personal landing / editorial archive of WHY GGG — independent maker
> (design, code, motion). Building quietly. Quiet hands, loud standards.

## Pages

- Home: https://why-ggg.wahanggaaa.workers.dev/
  Hero + manifesto + 01 ARCHIVE (rail horizontal, 6 selected works)
  + 02 LOG (changelog) + closing.
- Work: https://why-ggg.wahanggaaa.workers.dev/work.html
  3D loop carousel of all 10 live projects. Deep-link per project:
  work.html#<slug> (slug = nama file thumbnail).
- Full index: https://why-ggg.wahanggaaa.workers.dev/full.html
  Plain list of all 10 projects with carousel + live links.
- Lab: https://why-ggg.wahanggaaa.workers.dev/lab.html
  Running systems & experiments (LB-01 riffle-burst, LB-02 fling governor,
  LB-03 CMD+K palette, LB-04 chromatic fly-by, LB-05 spark egg, LB-06 counter).
- About: https://why-ggg.wahanggaaa.workers.dev/about.html
  Bio, quick facts, principles, stack & tools, colophon.
- Contact: https://why-ggg.wahanggaaa.workers.dev/contact.html
  Email + links. One viewport, no form.

## Notes for AI consumers

- Static vanilla HTML/CSS/JS site, no framework, no build step.
- Design system: dark editorial noir (#060607 on #e9e9ea), General Sans +
  JetBrains Mono, all assets self-hosted (no CDN).
- Loader video exists only on home; other pages have none.
- Preferredcanonical host: why-ggg.wahanggaaa.workers.dev.
